mechanism: Lactulose lowers colonic pH and reduces gentamicin absorption from the GI tract, potentially decreasing gentamicin bioavailability when given orally, though gentamicin is typically administered parenterally.
action: If gentamicin is given orally (rare, usually for hepatic encephalopathy), separate administration times by 2+ hours; monitor renal function and gentamicin levels as lactulose may affect systemic exposure depending on route and clinical context.
